description: This file contains unit tests and fuzzing for the FlatMap data structure, including correctness, performance, and edge case testing.

classes.name: MapTester
classes.description: A helper class for testing FlatMap correctness by shadowing operations to std::map and comparing for equality.

methods.name: StringPairEquals
methods.description: Checks if two pairs of strings are equal.

methods.name: FlipCoin
methods.description: Returns true or false randomly, simulating a coin flip.

methods.name: Random
methods.description: Generates a random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: CheckMapEquality
methods.description: Checks if two maps are equal in size and content.

methods.name: GetThreadTimeMonotonicNow
methods.description: Returns the current thread's monotonic time, falling back to system time if unavailable.

methods.name: MapToString
methods.description: Converts a map to a string representation for debugging.
